effect: The screen made a sheltered nook beneath the bench, completing the chapter. The beds and warm tank can be moved there if the cabin cools, while the seat and worktop remain usable.
reaction: I like that the nook has a practical contingency without taking the beds away from their sunny shelf yet.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heat store was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how a separate heat-exchange circuit captures processor waste heat for gradual release.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the inner screen was the least engaging passage; its result gave little detail until it was fitted to the bench.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the tank stays connected to collect fresh waste heat and can later be disconnected and moved with the beds.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The screen’s purpose was initially somewhat unclear, but fitting it to the bench explained it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the heat recovery and adaptable growing nook made me curious how the expedition will use what it has built.
